notes.title: CZO Winter Edition
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/1SLleVH.png

- CZO (WE) + adding winter mode to 4 maps
- fixed tilts to the right and left
- fixed wall on factory (bullets fly by the player does not let in)
- added sounds of walking on snow (surface detection)
- added surface (snow)
- 3 last floors + rearranged spawns (house of pain map)
- UI improver main menu optimization for Winter Edition
- fixed minimaps (removed tilt, increased size)
- fixed sounds of steps on the surface (grass, sand, rock, etc.)
- fixed Alien character
- added Santa Claus character
- Factory (fixed maps + bots no longer walk through containers + collider for one container (was without collider))
- fixed ak74 and mka upon reaching level 6-7
- keys on Kill Streak (5,6,7) by default
- added anti-cheat (Autoban, report, request to kick player, mute)
